pages.text: Altered from $(5)Sharpness$(), $(4)Xenophobia$() greatly increases damage against people. Maximum level is $(4)V$() and it conflicts with $(5)Sharpness$(), $(5)Smite$(), $(5)Bane of Arthropods$(), $(4)Velocity$(), and $(4)Heavenfall$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Xenophobia is the best option to use when fighting Raids. It does, however, make killing people easier, not only Pillagers. It is highly dangerous in the hands of the wrong person.
